title: Built a full 2D Pixel-Art Idle ARPG on Android (Melvor × Diablo × Tibia) as a solo dev (~12h/week) using an AI-assisted workflow. Would love your feedback!
author: YakFederal3939
selftext:
Hey everyone! Working \~12 hours a week alongside AI coding agents (using a strict `CLAUDE.md`operational context and +1,530 automated tests to keep the AI hallucination-free), I just launched the permanent world for **Idle Rift RPG** on Google Play.

Instead of another spreadsheet clicker, it’s a real grid-based dungeon crawler:

* ⚔️ **Auto or Manual:** Set skill gambits for 100% idle play, or pop the manual joystick to dodge boss combos and hunt chests.
* 🔨 **Deep Progression:** Start as a Rookie, unlock 5 vocations by training weapon skills, farm 19 zones, and master Mining, Smelting, Smithing & Jewelcrafting.
* 🛡️ **Zero P2W Traps:** No energy bars, no chest timers, and failed forge upgrades *never* destroy your gear.
* 🌐 **Async Social:** Find real players' RIP gravestones in your dungeons, join Guilds, and fight the Weekly Boss.

📲 **Download on Google Play:** [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kotmstudios.idleriftrpg](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kotmstudios.idleriftrpg)

If you have a few minutes to try it out, I’d love to know what you think. And if you enjoy it, **leaving a 5-star rating/review on Google Play** helps a solo dev immensely against the algorithm!
